verses.en: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.pt: Que diremos, pois? Permaneceremos no pecado, para que abunde a graça?
verses.en_web: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.en_bbe: What may we say, then? are we to go on in sin so that there may be more grace?

verses.en: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.pt: De modo nenhum. Nós, que já morremos para o pecado, como viveremos ainda nele?
verses.en_web: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
verses.en_bbe: In no way. How may we, who are dead to sin, be living in it any longer?

verses.en: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.pt: Ou, porventura, ignorais que todos quantos fomos batizados em Cristo Jesus fomos batizados na sua morte?
verses.en_web: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.en_bbe: Or are you without the knowledge that all we who had baptism into Christ Jesus, had baptism into his death?

verses.en: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.pt: Fomos, pois, sepultados com ele pelo batismo na morte, para que, como Cristo foi ressuscitado dentre os mortos pela glória do Pai, assim andemos nós também em novidade de vida.
verses.en_web: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
verses.en_bbe: We have been placed with him among the dead through baptism into death: so that as Christ came again from the dead by the glory of the Father, we, in the same way, might be living in new life.

verses.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.pt: Porque, se temos sido unidos a ele na semelhança da sua morte, certamente também o seremos na semelhança da sua ressurreição;
verses.en_web: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;
verses.en_bbe: For, if we have been made like him in his death, we will, in the same way, be like him in his coming to life again;

verses.en: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.pt: sabendo isto, que o nosso homem velho foi crucificado com ele, para que o corpo do pecado fosse desfeito, a fim de não servirmos mais ao pecado.
verses.en_web: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.
verses.en_bbe: Being conscious that our old man was put to death on the cross with him, so that the body of sin might be put away, and we might no longer be servants to sin.

verses.en: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.pt: Pois quem está morto está justificado do pecado.
verses.en_web: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
verses.en_bbe: Because he who is dead is free from sin.

verses.en: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.pt: Ora, se já morremos com Cristo, cremos que também com ele viveremos,
verses.en_web: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;
verses.en_bbe: But if we are dead with Christ, we have faith that we will be living with him;

verses.en: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.pt: sabendo que, tendo Cristo ressurgido dentre os mortos, já não morre mais; a morte não mais tem domínio sobre ele.
verses.en_web: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!
verses.en_bbe: Having knowledge that because Christ has come back from the dead, he will never again go down to the dead; death has no more power over him.

verses.en: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.pt: Pois quanto a ter morrido, de uma vez por todas morreu para o pecado, mas quanto a viver, vive para Deus.
verses.en_web: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.
verses.en_bbe: For his death was a death to sin, but his life now is a life which he is living to God.

verses.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.pt: Assim também vós considerai-vos como mortos para o pecado, mas vivos para Deus, em Cristo Jesus.
verses.en_web: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Even so see yourselves as dead to sin, but living to God in Christ Jesus.

verses.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.pt: Não reine, portanto, o pecado em vosso corpo mortal, para obedecerdes às suas concupiscências;
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause do not let sin be ruling in your body which is under the power of death, so that you give way to its desires;

verses.en: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.pt: nem tampouco apresenteis os vossos membros ao pecado como instrumentos de iniqüidade; mas apresentai-vos a Deus, como redivivos dentre os mortos, e os vossos membros a Deus, como instrumentos de justiça.
verses.en_web: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
verses.en_bbe: And do not give your bodies to sin as the instruments of wrongdoing, but give yourselves to God, as those who are living from the dead, and your bodies as instruments of righteousness to God.

verses.en: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.pt: Pois o pecado não terá domínio sobre vós, porquanto não estais debaixo da lei, mas debaixo da graça.
verses.en_web: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.
verses.en_bbe: For sin may not have rule over you: because you are not under law, but under grace.

verses.en: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.pt: Pois quê? Havemos de pecar porque não estamos debaixo da lei, mas debaixo da graça? De modo nenhum.
verses.en_web: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!
verses.en_bbe: What then? are we to go on in sin because we are not under law but under grace? Let it not be so.

verses.en: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.pt: Não sabeis que daquele a quem vos apresentais como servos para lhe obedecer, sois servos desse mesmo a quem obedeceis, seja do pecado para a morte, ou da obediência para a justiça?
verses.en_web: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?
verses.en_bbe: Are you not conscious that you are the servants of him to whom you give yourselves to do his desire? if to sin, the end being death, or if to do the desire of God, the end being righteousness.

verses.en: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.pt: Mas graças a Deus que, embora tendo sido servos do pecado, obedecestes de coração à forma de doutrina a que fostes entregues;
verses.en_web: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.
verses.en_bbe: But praise be to God that though you were the servants of sin, you have now given yourselves freely to that form of teaching under which you were placed;

verses.en: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.pt: e libertos do pecado, fostes feitos servos da justiça.
verses.en_web: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: And being made free from sin you have been made the servants of righteousness.

verses.en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.pt: Falo como homem, por causa da fraqueza da vossa carne. Pois assim como apresentastes os vossos membros como servos da impureza e da iniqüidade para iniqüidade, assim apresentai agora os vossos membros como servos da justiça para santificação.
verses.en_web: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.
verses.en_bbe: I am using words in the way of men, because your flesh is feeble: as you gave your bodies as servants to what is unclean, and to evil to do evil, so now give them as servants to righteousness to do what is holy.

verses.en: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.pt: Porque, quando éreis servos do pecado, estáveis livres em relação à justiça.
verses.en_web: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: When you were servants of sin you were free from righteousness.

verses.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.pt: E que fruto tínheis então das coisas de que agora vos envergonhais? pois o fim delas é a morte.
verses.en_web: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.en_bbe: What fruit had you at that time in the things which are now a shame to you? for the end of such things is death.

verses.en: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.pt: Mas agora, libertos do pecado, e feitos servos de Deus, tendes o vosso fruto para santificação, e por fim a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: But now, being free from sin, and having been made servants to God, you have your fruit in that which is holy, and the end is eternal life.

verses.en: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.pt: Porque o salário do pecado é a morte, mas o dom gratuito de Deus é a vida eterna em Cristo Jesus nosso Senhor.
verses.en_web: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.en_bbe: For the reward of sin is death; but what God freely gives is eternal life in Jesus Christ our Lord.
